cache.title: Cache Settings
cache.description: Configure cache behavior for IOC analysis results
cache.enabledDescription: Store analysis results to avoid repeated API calls
cache.retentionDescription: How long to keep cached results
cache.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all cached data?

info.whyDescription: The cache system stores the results of previously analyzed IOCs on your device. This way, when you query the same IOC again, you get instant results without making an API call.
info.benefit1: ⚡ Fast Results: Repeated queries respond instantly
info.benefit2: 📊 API Quota Protection: Preserves your daily/monthly API limits
info.benefit3: 🔒 Privacy: Data is stored only on your device
info.benefit4: 💾 Offline Access: Access previous results without internet
info.howDescription: Every successful analysis result is automatically cached. Old entries are automatically deleted after the period you specify. You can manually clear all cache at any time.
